context: Grandpa tells Sho about old days, with archaic register.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: elder storytelling; archaic/negation forms (ぬ/無い/全く/八) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、昔は車あったの?
lines.en: Grandpa, were there cars long ago?
lines.style: curious small child voice, bright warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: 昔は、車など全く無かったのじゃ。
lines.en: Long ago there were no cars at all.
lines.style: gravelly old man voice, soft warm slow nostalgic delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: えっ、じゃあどうやって行ったの?
lines.en: Huh, then how did you get around?
lines.style: surprised small child voice, bright warm wide-eyed delivery throughout

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: 歩くしか、道は無かったのよ。
lines.en: There was no way but to walk.
lines.style: gravelly old man voice, soft warm slow nostalgic delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Even if it was far, you walked?
lines.style: amazed small child voice, bright warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: 八里の道も、歩いて行かねばならぬ。
lines.en: Even a road of eight ri, we had to walk.
lines.style: gravelly old man voice, soft warm slow nostalgic delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: engaged small child voice, bright warm curious delivery throughout

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: その後、村にも一台、八台と増えたわ。
lines.en: After that, the village got one, then eight.
lines.style: gravelly old man voice, soft warm fond nostalgic delivery throughout
